annotations.title: CSV preflight, validate CSV: check CSV text before importing: problems, delimiter, row and column types

description:
Check CSV text before importing: returns a verdict (ok), problems with line numbers (empty or missing header, no data rows, ragged rows with field counts, duplicate headers, mixed column types, unterminated quotes, mojibake), the detected delimiter and a per-column type report. Use before ingesting a CSV export. Example: text=name,age
Ada,36
Bob,41. Price $0.01/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits), first 25 free; failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.
